propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py) has zero live callers after bug 3b5f removed the producer and dispatch arms.
Deletion is safe and behavior-neutral because the outbound probe leaf (_apply_outbound_probe) remains untouched and live, and deletion detection lives in outbound_differ._safe_get_issue.
Re-homing the port to binding_walk must not happen because an earlier operator ruling forbids same-pass re-creation of confirmed-deleted issues, removing the port's original purpose.
The port is provably dead per AGENTS.md: semantic search (Serena) returned empty, and string grep found hits only in the port itself, its tests, and prose documentation.

Deletion orphans the resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses, reconciler.resolved_statuses) which are deferred to a follow-up ticket (549c-032f-6cb0-4258) for a separate deprecate-vs-remove decision.
